title: RBI External Commercial Borrowing (ECB) Framework 2026 ($1B / 300% Net Worth)
summary: RBI notified FEMA Borrowing & Lending First Amendment Regulations 2026: Automatic ECB limit raised from $750M to higher of $1B or 300% net worth; minimum 3-year maturity; acquisition of control permitted.

blocks.content: **Overview**: RBI notified FEMA Borrowing & Lending First Amendment Regulations 2026: Automatic ECB limit raised from $750M to higher of $1B or 300% net worth; minimum 3-year maturity; acquisition of control permitted.

items: **RBI notifies amended ECB framework, replaces cap with higher of $1B or 300% net worth** (Page 15): RBI notified FEMA Borrowing & Lending First Amendment Regulations 2026: Automatic ECB limit raised from $750M to higher of $1B or 300% net worth; minimum 3-year maturity; acquisition of control permitted.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under External Debt & Foreign Exchange Management. Liberalizes external borrowing limits replacing $750M cap.
